title: Standard generators for the integral-model projective-line twist
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $d\in\mathbf Z$. On $\mathbf P^1_k$ with the standard opens of [def-sc-p1-standard], the integral-model twisting module $\operatorname{ProjectiveSpace.twist}(d)$ [def-pc-projective-space-twist] admits $\operatorname{TwistData}$ [def-sc-p1-standard]: generators $g_0,g_1$ trivializing it on every subopen of $D_+(x_0),D_+(x_1)$ and satisfying $g_0=(x_0/x_1)^d g_1$ on the intersection.

source.place: Tags 01MN, 01M7 (2),(3); Section 01MM, homogeneous fraction charts; parent proof step 2, integral-model trivializations

proof.text: On the integral polynomial Proj, restrict the fraction section X_i/X_j to the intersection of the variable charts. Evaluate its value at each point using awayToSection_apply and Away.val_mk; the value is Localization.mk X_i X_j. The opposite ratio has value Localization.mk X_j X_i. Their product is one by Localization.mk_mul and the localization equality criterion (witness 1), giving a unit c.

At each point the degree-d chart generator twistPowSection is X_i^(d.toNat)/X_i^((-d).toNat). Split d into ofNat m and negSucc m. In the first case c^d has numerator X_i^m and denominator X_j^m; in the second its value uses the opposite ratio to the power m+1. In both cases the transition equality reduces under Localization.mk_mul to a polynomial multiplication identity. The localization relation uses witness 1; this includes d=0 and also i=j.

Pull back both generators along toProjInt. The existing isFreeGenerator_twistPowSection and pullback_unit_app lemmas supply the two bijective scalar maps on every subopen. Apply pullbackSection to the integral transition equation and use pullbackSection_map and pullbackSection_smul. Naturality of the structure-sheaf map identifies the image of c with ratioUnit. Units.map preserves integer powers, so its image c^d is transitionUnit. Assemble the generators, bijectivity proofs and overlap equality into TwistData.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01MN and 01M7, Section 01MM; fully checked K3 fraction calculation and pullback of generators.
